title: BIOSZEN
description: BIOSZEN is an R/Shiny application and R package for reproducible biological data analysis and visualization from Excel files. It generates boxplots, bar plots, violin plots, stacked plots, heatmaps, correlation plots, and concentration-response (dose-response) curves with configurable multi-strain visualization, raw or normalized responses, IC50 estimation, model diagnostics, and statistical comparisons. It also provides metadata-based reproducibility, downloadable graphics and workbooks, normality and significance tests, and flexible microbial growth-curve parameter extraction from fixed or irregular/discontinuous numeric time points.
